privacy_and_reproducibility: Only original public file references and aggregate source IDs/day counts; no individual IDs, precise GPS positions, exact daily dates or animal paths shared.
CSV content parsed in ephemeral analysis; no original source data copied to this PR or CI.
Per-cohort original files are CC0 per published rights metadata; appropriate citations and potential wildlife geoprivacy still apply.
Release-year groups are provisional comparable cohorts, NOT three independently replicated taxa or proven real resource-use populations.
Actual R/X/T/E studies require same individual set, matched contexts and uncertainty calibration, not evidence of source tracking only.
